column2: Homicide Investigator's ability triggers for each of them
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text (template error; conclusion D in ruling-conflicts-2, case 2; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5; register homicide-investigator-triggers-once): the 2024-04-12 ruling has the ability trigger 'for each of them' when Homicide Investigator dies with other nontoken creatures you control, against both sentences of the Oracle text, 'Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, investigate. This ability triggers only once each turn.' Likely origin: Midnight Reaper's ruling (2018-10-05; Guilds of Ravnica release notes) 'If Midnight Reaper dies at the same time as one or more other nontoken creatures you control, Midnight Reaper's ability triggers for each of them.', written for a per-creature trigger ('Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies') and copied with the name swapped, together with its companion ruling (which agrees with the card and is cited); G'raha Tia's ruling (2025-06-06) answers the same question for the same template the other way ('its last ability will trigger once'). The engine follows the Oracle text (tests/rulings/r_p005_dies.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
